extracted.intended_audience: Napoleonic-era French ministers, military commanders, and colonial administrators responsible for the Illyrian provinces
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and operational principles for the military defence, fortification prioritization, civil & military administration, recruitment, and justice organization of the Illyrian provinces (early 19th-century context). Advises ministers and field commanders on which places to fortify, how to organize Croatian regiments, and how to maintain local institutions to preserve order and loyalty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Destroy Sachsenbourg
rubrics_metrics.description: «Le fort de Sachsenbourg doit être détruit, parce qu'il n'est susceptible d'aucune augmentation; qu'il est tellement plongé, que ce serait jeter son argent sans résultat... »
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a fort cannot be meaningfully improved or brought to useful defensive standard, demolish it rather than waste resources; a deeply sunk/obsolete fortification that cannot be upgraded will not justify expenditure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Villach has limited defensive value
rubrics_metrics.description: «Villach paraît susceptible de peu de chose; du moins tout serait à faire.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not invest heavily where substantial work would be required for little return; consider withdrawing or minimally holding such locations rather than costly reconstruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control the Drave to hold alpine slopes
rubrics_metrics.description: «Le cours de la Drave, dont nous sommes en possession, a l'important avantage de nous rendre maîtres du versant des eaux, et de nous permettre de choisir les positions que nous devons occuper sur la chaîne des Alpes.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Possession of the Drave gives the ability to select and occupy advantageous alpine positions — prioritise holding river valleys that grant control of mountain approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Isonzo and mountain chain as primary defensive line
rubrics_metrics.description: «La vraie défense est sur l'Isonzo et les montagnes. ... Il ne faut donc pas établir aucune offensive au delà des Alpes, aucune défensive au delà de l'Isonzo; on sera prévenu par l'ennemi.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the Isonzo river and the adjacent mountains the principal defence; avoid attempting to defend permanently beyond it or to launch offensives beyond the Alps that cannot be sustained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Palmanova insufficient to command Isonzo
rubrics_metrics.description: «Un des grands désavantages de la place de Palmanova est qu'elle ne nous rend pas maîtres de l'Isonzo.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Palmanova alone does not secure the Isonzo crossings; if constructing new fortifications, locate them directly on the Isonzo (e.g., Gorizia, Gradiska, Osoppo) to control river passages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select and fortify key points on Isonzo to permit army crossing
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il faudrait l'établir à Goritzia, Gradiska, ou tout autre point, qu'il faudrait chercher et choisir sur l'Isonzo, qui fasse que l'armée puisse repasser l'Isonzo et être maîtresse de le passer quand elle voudra.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify positions on the Isonzo that guarantee control of crossing points so your army can cross or withdraw at will; these are strategic priorities for new works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritise two barrier points to interdict main roads
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il faudrait reconnaître quel est le point qu'il faut occuper pour être maître du chemin d'Osoppo à Villach... S'il y avait là deux points qu'on pût occuper, cela mériterait la peine de dépenser un million sur chaque point, de manière que l'ennemi ne pût déboucher par ce chemin sans prendre les forts, ce qui exigerait quinze ou seize jours.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If two strong positions can block principal roads (Osoppo–Villach, Tarvis–Caporetto via Gorizia), it is worth investing large sums (order-of-magnitude: ~1 million each) to delay the enemy 15–16 days; focus on interdicting main roads rather than preventing passage of light troops.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interdiction target: main chaussée (highway), not light troops
rubrics_metrics.description: «On ne prétend pas l'empêcher de passer avec de l'infanterie, de la cavalerie, et des divisions légères, mais intercepter la chaussée: c'est de la grande route qu'il est question de se rendre maître.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fortify to deny the main enemy lines of communications and movement (the principal roads), accepting that light forces can bypass fixed works but cannot move heavy formations without taking the forts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay as strategic objective (value of days gained)
rubrics_metrics.description: Arguments repeated: retaining obstacles that delay the enemy by 4–5 days (or 5–6 days if they detour via Laybach) yields decisive time for formation, relief, or offensive operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify fortification choices by how many days they delay hostile movement; gaining even 4–8 days can change operational outcomes — choose positions that maximize delay on likely enemy approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abandon large offensives beyond the Julian Alps
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il ne faut penser à établir aucune offensive sur le pendant des Alpes Juliennes, ni aucune défensive au delà de l'Isonzo.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid planning sustained offensive or defensive commitments on the far side of the Julian Alps; commit resources to defensible terrain on your side of the passes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conserve castle works, remove vulnerable constructions
rubrics_metrics.description: On Laybach and Trieste: «il est bon de conserver le château en l'améliorant... d'y détruire tous les bâtiments et constructions qui pourraient le mettre dans le cas d'être pris par les obus.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preserve and modestly improve strongholds (castles) while removing nearby structures that increase vulnerability to bombardment; annual modest works can be worthwhile.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess garrison endurance before investment
rubrics_metrics.description: «Il restera à savoir si les six cents hommes qu'on pourrait laisser dans ce fort pourraient s'y défendre trente ou quarante jours... Il est plus avantageux de le conserver que de le détruire; mais on ne doit le considérer que comme un simple fort qu'il faut améliorer.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Estimate how long a contemplated garrison could hold (e.g., 30–40 days) and use that as a justification for relative expenditure; accept potential loss of a small garrison if the strategic benefit of holding the position justifies the cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trieste: limited fortification benefit vs. policing/commerce role
rubrics_metrics.description: «Mêmes raisons au fort de Trieste; il est utile pour mettre la police contre les Anglais, maintenir une ville populeuse et commerçante, et assurer les communications... À moins de dépenses considérables, il est douteux qu'on puisse fortifier ce château de manière à le mettre en état de se défendre quinze à vingt jours.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain Trieste for policing, commercial protection, and communications, but do not expect cost-effective fortifications to render it a long-term bastion without heavy expenditure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concentrate arsenals and stores on secure sites (avoid left bank of Isonzo)
rubrics_metrics.description: «...il ne doit y avoir aucun établissement sérieux sur la rive gauche de l'Isonzo, aucun arsenal, magasins de fusils ni d'artillerie; tout doit être à Palmanova, Venise, Mantoue, et, si on veut, à Osoppo et Zara.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid placing critical military stores on exposed river-left (enemy-facing) banks; centralize magazines and arsenals at secure, inland depots to prevent easy capture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain ability to evacuate beyond-Isonzo country within 4 days
rubrics_metrics.description: «On doit être constamment en mesure d'évacuer en quatre jours de temps tout le pays au delà de l'Isonzo...»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan logistics and dispositions so that forces and civil administration can withdraw from forward provinces within a short, specified window (four days) if strategic situation requires it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat Illyrian provinces as complement to Frioul, not independent theatre
rubrics_metrics.description: «En résumé, les provinces illyriennes, considérées sous les points de vue de guerre, ne doivent être regardées que comme complétant la possession du Frioul. Si on les considérait autrement, on s'exposerait à de grands malheurs...»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame policy for Illyria as supporting the security of Frioul; avoid independent political/administrative aims that conflict with military defensive needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritise fortifications that intercept Carinthia–Frioul communications
rubrics_metrics.description: «Si, à cause de ces obstacles, l'ennemi ne vient point par Klagenfurth et vient par Laybach, ce serait un détour de quatre ou cinq jours... Gagner cinq à six jours... n'est pas un petit objet. ... ce premier de ces objets [interception de la Carinthie] [est] beaucoup plus important que le second [Isonzo].»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give priority to positions that block the Carinthian approaches into Frioul (which are the most dangerous ingress), even over other works on the Isonzo, because they can generate larger strategic delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selective heavy investment — few key works over many small ones
rubrics_metrics.description: «S'il y avait là deux points qu'on pût occuper, cela mériterait la peine de dépenser un million sur chaque point... S'il est nécessaire de faire une dépense de quelques millions, ce serait dans une ou deux places qui intercepteraient la communication de la Carinthie... »
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer concentrating major expenditures on one or two decisive strongpoints that control communications rather than dispersing funds across many minor works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Illyrian provinces as force-multipliers (Dalmatia as vanguard & navy recruitment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advantages enumerated: Dalmatia's army not divided, can form vanguard; Dalmatia provides mariners and naval recruits for the flotilla; Dalmatie helps cover rear communications (Zara garrison).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exploit local geographic and demographic advantages: use Dalmatia to supply vanguard forces and seafaring manpower, and integrate coastal garrisons into broader operational plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep Croatie militaire organization intact (don't import civil justice system)
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeated warning: proposed organizational changes (justice/administration) would 'détruir tout le système de la justice dans la Croatie militaire' and 'détruiraient les régiments croates' by removing powers from military authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preserve the existing integrated military-administrative system for Croatian regiments; avoid transplanting ordinary civil institutions that would disrupt recruitment, discipline, and local acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company-level conciliation tribunals for civil disputes
rubrics_metrics.description: «C'est un tribunal de famille, un tribunal paternel; ... Le capitaine de chaque compagnie, un lieutenant de l'économie, deux sous-officiers nommés à tour de rôle, deux soldats également choisis ... forment ce qu'on appelle une session, qui s'assemble une fois la semaine.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use localized, low-cost weekly 'family' tribunals composed of company officers/NCOs and soldiers to resolve small civil disputes, to keep justice accessible and economical for a poor, dispersed population.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use auditeur (legally trained officer) & regimental appellate structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Serious/obscure cases before a legally trained 'auditeur'; twenty officers witness and sign procès-verbal; appeals go to regimental appellate tribunal or civil tribunal at Carlstadt if necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine legal expertise (auditeur) with military forms to adjudicate complex matters, and provide an appellate layer (regimental or small civil bench at Carlstadt) that remains accessible and inexpensive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military procedure for criminal justice (council of war with auditor)
rubrics_metrics.description: «La justice criminelle se rend par un conseil de guerre, présidé par le major et composé des officiers supérieurs... L'instruction ... est faite par le premier auditeur du régiment... Dans certains cas... la sentence... est exécutée immédiatement. Dans tous les autres, elle doit être revisée au tribunal d'appel des régiments.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For criminal cases, use a military council of war presided by senior officers with instruction by the regimental auditeur; reserve immediate execution only for grave public-safety offences; otherwise submit sentences to appellate review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not transfer police correctionnelle/criminal jurisdiction from military chiefs
rubrics_metrics.description: «Donner au tribunal civil la police correctionnelle et la justice criminelle; dans tous les cas, ôter l'une et l'autre aux chefs militaires, c'est détruire les régiments croates, car c'est ôter une grande partie de leur puissance aux officiers.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Retaining these jurisdictions in military hands is essential to preserve discipline and the organizational integrity of the regiments; moving them to civilian courts risks breakdown of order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Justice must be near, inexpensive, and tailored to poor population
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeated emphasis that the Croates are poor; their petty disputes are for small sums; court must be near ('le plus près d'eux possible'), without fees, and avoid imposing costs or distant travel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design legal institutions to minimize travel and fees for litigants — proximity and low cost are essential to maintain social order and legitimacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concentrate powers to maintain order in a 'camp' society
rubrics_metrics.description: «La Croatie ne doit pas être considérée comme une province, mais comme un camp, et sa population comme une armée... Il a fallu et il faut, pour soutenir un pareil système, concentrer les pouvoirs.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In populations organized primarily for military service and of limited wealth/administrative capacity, centralize authority (military-led administration) rather than multiplying civilian institutions, to avoid chaos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place French officers & Dalmatian officers strategically
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations: place a chef de bataillon per regiment; propose a French officer per company by exchange; Dalmatian officers placed to serve as trustworthy young men who know local language and report happenings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mix French officers to infuse the French service ethos and Dalmatian/local officers to act as interpreters/liaisons; use exchanges to place officers without alienating locals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Habillement (clothing) policy: do not raise taxes; favour state provision only if not onerous
rubrics_metrics.description: Officers requested government provide clothing by retaining the twelve florins given to families; Marmont warns that without giving the clothing via the state's taking of the existing levy at five-sixths, increased taxation would impoverish families and provoke emigration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid reforms that impose new monetary burdens for uniforms on poor families; if the state provides clothing, do so by reallocating existing levies rather than adding taxes or creating unaffordable requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid long fixed garrisoning of Croatian troops abroad
rubrics_metrics.description: «Ces troupes doivent combattre ou rester chez elles, et que les tenir en garnison fixe est aussi contraire à leur institution qu'à leur esprit... Rien ne contrarierait plus l'esprit de l'organisation de ces troupes et leur conservation.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer short domestic camps (e.g., three months) to year-long distant garrisons; preserving the troops' local ties sustains recruitment, morale, and low cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: First employment matters for political loyalty
rubrics_metrics.description: Concern that sending Croates initially on missions painted negatively by Austrians (e.g., to Spain) could damage future recruitment and loyalty; the manner of first wartime employment will shape opinion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be careful in assigning first external deployments: choose early employments that present troops well and encourage continued loyalty and recruitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruitment/regimental geography: organize regiments by local regions
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal for three regiments recruited respectively from high Carniole & Villach, lower Carniole & Adelsberg/Istria/Trieste region, and Lower-Carniole & civil Croatia; include Dalmatia for mariners and possibly two frontier regiments in Dalmatian mountains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design recruitment zones to blend weaker contingents (e.g., Carinthians) among stronger ones, concentrate maritime recruitment where appropriate, and create frontier regiments for local mountain defence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utilize discharged Austrian soldiers as a reserve/formation resource
rubrics_metrics.description: Example: forming a volunteer reserve company from discharged Austrian soldiers to staff a Trieste flotilla (company of eighty men).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where suitable personnel exist among discharged enemy soldiers, integrate them as voluntary reserve units to fill gaps (e.g., flotilla crews) and rapidly augment garrisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Draft and defend a single integrated Illyrian administrative project
rubrics_metrics.description: Marmont reports work with intendant général and conseiller général de justice to produce a single projet d'organisation générale des provinces illyriennes to answer objections in Paris.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate administrative, fiscal and judicial reforms as an integrated package, and circulate a consolidated project with on-the-ground participation to preempt harmful Parisian changes that ignore local realities.
